Fixed. 63 tests pass, including the byte-for-byte no-extras invariant.

**Root cause:** `_swap_command` built `uv tool install --force --from git+…@v7.0.0 agentalloy[code-index]`. uv reads the trailing `agentalloy[code-index]` as a separate requirement and rejects it because the `--from` source carries no extras — hence *"requirement provided with `--from` conflicts with install request."* This only triggers when the prior install had an extra (your code-index), so `_detect_installed_extras` re-requested it.

**Fix** (`upgrade.py:196`): extras now ride on the `--from` PEP 508 direct reference, trailing arg stays bare `agentalloy` — the same form the pip fallback already used correctly:

```
uv tool install --force --from "agentalloy[code-index] @ git+…@v7.0.0" agentalloy
```

No-extras path is unchanged. Note the port-bind error (`47950 address already in use`) in your log is a separate, pre-existing condition — the failed CLI swap left the old container up; a clean re-run after this ships should proceed.
